news.title: Messi makes first public appearance in Rosario after World Cup heartbreak
news.lede: Lionel Messi has made his first public appearance since Argentina's heartbreaking defeat to Spain in the 2026 FIFA World Cup final. The Argentina captain attended a Primera C league match between Leones FC -- a club run by his family -- and Central Córdoba on Saturday at the Antonio Di Giacomo Stadium in Arroyo Seco, near his hometown of Rosario, where he is spending time with his family before resuming club duties with Inter Miami. Although Messi arrived after kickoff wearing a black hoodie in an attempt to keep a low profile, the eight-time Ballon d'Or winner was quickly recognised by supporters. Television cameras and fans' mobile phones captured him watching the match from a balcony behind one of the goals.

news.title: Luis de la Fuente calls Arsenal star 'second best in the world' after World Cup win
news.lede: Martin Zubimendi is the second-best midfielder in the world behind Rodri, says Luis de la Fuente (Getty) Luis de la Fuente believes Arsenal’s Martin Zubimendi is the second-best midfielder in the world behind Rodri following Spain’s World Cup success. Rodri captained Spain to victory over Argentina in the World Cup final last weekend and also beat Lionel Messi to win the Golden Ball, which is awarded to the best player in the tournament. Zubimendi, meanwhile, made just one substitute appearance during the World Cup as he replaced Rodri in the first half of extra time in last Sunday’s final. But despite his lack of minutes during Spain’s World Cup campaign, De la Fuente is keen to stress the importance of the Arsenal midfielder in his squad.

news.title: Bayern Munich among top five clubs to be compensated by FIFA following World Cup
news.lede: The relationship between club and international football has always been shaky at best. Clubs fear injuries that could derail an entire season while international teams pine for their nation’s top talents — a complex conflict of interest. Nowhere is the conflict as prominent as the FIFA World Cup. Clubs have no choice but to surrender their talent to their national teams.

news.title: De la Fuente: I have a sixth sense, Yamal is a genius, and I am not thinking about the 2030 World Cup
news.lede: The Spain national team's door is open to Morata and Carvajal. Luis de la Fuente is the most talked-about manager on the planet right now, having steered Spain to World Cup glory at Argentina's expense. La Roja lifted the trophy for the second time in their history, edging Argentina 1-0 after extra time. Speaking to AS newspaper, De la Fuente laid bare the secrets behind a side that has now won Euro 2024 and the 2026 World Cup.

news.title: 'Don't retire yet': Di María makes desperate plea to Lionel Messi after Argentina's World Cup agony
news.lede: Ángel Di María has urged Lionel Messi not to retire from international football following Argentina's heartbreaking defeat to Spain in the 2026 FIFA World Cup final, insisting the captain should continue representing his country for "many more years" despite another painful ending on football's biggest stage. Football News: Ángel Di María has made a heartfelt plea to Lionel Messi, urging him not to retire from international football after Argentina's narrow loss to Spain in the 2026 FIFA World Cup final. Di María believes Messi can represent Argentina for many more years, highlighting his remarkable performances during the tournament even at age 39.
